Peak season, busy and bright
The welfare crew are ready
Ready for the
Companion Animal Travel Desk
Quiet handling, steady pacing, and clear handoffs remain our standard as Aurelia Skyways keeps pet movements smooth across the network. The team welcomes questions in a warm professional tone and gives every animal patient attention from trained staff. <<FACT F021>> We also keep crate checks, water stops, and comfort routines simple and consistent, so travelers can plan with confidence and staff can work with a steady flow.

At the counter, the process stays calm, humane, and practical from arrival through boarding. That approach helps reduce stress for nervous pets and supports tidy operations for the wider station team. Bring documents early, label carriers clearly, and allow room for a careful welfare review. We are ready for the next busy wave and will keep standards firm throughout the season.
